title: Demolish popover left on the win_w anchor regime: with the rail on it can slide under the rail plate (drawn before it) while remaining hit-testable
evidence:
popover.odin:
	w := hud_f(v, POPOVER_W)
	x := anchor.x + hud_f(v, 18)
	y := anchor.y - hud_f(v, 20)
	if x + w > f32(v.win_w) { x = anchor.x - w - hud_f(v, 18) }
main.odin (draw order):
			rnd.draw_demolish_popover(&app.view, &app.state.topology, &app.cat, app.input.sel_node, app.input.sel_pipe)
...
				rnd.draw_noc_overlay(&app.view, &app.noc_feed, &app.stats, &app.state.topology, &app.state.bundles, &app.cat, app.state.events[:], app.input.sel_pipe, u32(len(app.state.flow.packets)), app.noc_scroll)
main.odin:1306:
			pop := rnd.popover_rect(&app.view, rnd.node_screen(&app.view, app.state.topology.node_pos[slot]), rnd.POPOVER_H_NODE)
detail: The diff migrates banner/modal/preview to play_w but not the popover: it flips only at win_w and draws before the rail, so a node in the playfield's right ~190px (e.g. anchor 600 -> popover 618..828, rail at 756) renders under the plate yet popover_ui_hit still fires — the same occlusion class the r1 W2 fix addressed for the upgrade preview.
recommended_fix: Flip/clamp popover_rect against v.play_w when view_rail_on(v) (single source, draw + hit-test share the rect already), or draw the popover after the rail; pin with a rect test.

title: Camera helper procs still take params named win_w documented as 'the window dims' while every call site now passes play_w
detail: The diff changed all call sites to pass play_w into parameters still named win_w whose docs say they are the window dims (camera_anchor_center, camera_pullback_target, camera_clamp_center). The signature now misstates its contract, inviting a future caller to pass win_w and reintroduce the under-rail bug.
recommended_fix: Rename the horizontal param to play_w (or field_w) in the three camera procs and update their doc comments to say playfield width; call sites are unchanged.

title: noc_panel_rect claims 'hit-test + the draw share it (single source)' but draw_noc_panel re-derives the plate inline from px - NOC_PLATE_PAD; noc_panel_x's comment mislabels the content edge as the rail edge
detail: The plate rect is expressed twice (noc_panel_rect for hit-test/pixels-check; px - NOC_PLATE_PAD for the draw) — algebraically equal today via shared constants but divergent under single-sided edits, against the repo's rect+draw-share doctrine (crisis_banner_rect precedent). Also noc_panel_x returns the content edge (win_w-516), not the rail's left edge (win_w-NOC_RAIL_W=win_w-524) its comment claims.
recommended_fix: Have draw_noc_panel paint the plate via noc_panel_rect(v.win_w, v.win_h) so the comment's single-source claim is true, and reword noc_panel_x's comment to 'the content column's left edge'.
